meta.title: Subagent panel
meta.description: Subagent panel for the right sidebar: one card per subagent, each showing the latest three lines of that subagent's conversation live (every card subscribes to its own child session, so new messages slide in). Cards are easy to tell apart - a first-character badge, a short #id suffix, a sturdier border and spacing - and each shows the provider and model that subagent actually runs on as two stacked lines (read from the child's modelSelection projection), immediately before the token and duration figures. Reachable from the sidebar's "+" guide, Ctrl+Shift+S, or by automatic placement when the sidebar is empty and the conversation already has subagents (closing is remembered per conversation). Four colour-coded states - running (animated accent arc), completed (green), ended abnormally (red), not running (hollow grey). Click a card for its detail: creation time, usage, and a longer preview that auto-scrolls to the newest message while the child runs. The trash control at the end of a card clears just that card; you can also stop a running subagent, clear all finished cards, or restore everything. Reads only session data already held by this client and makes no model requests; clearing only hides cards and deletes nothing.
